column3: NASB follows the critical text without “for”; “before” is rendered “in the sight of.”
NASB adds “borne” and renders “in its own proper times” as “at the proper time.”
NASB follows the critical text without “in Christ”; it puts the aside in parentheses and renders “herald” as “preacher.”
NASB renders “I desire” as “I want” and “anger” as “wrath.”
NASB follows the critical text (“and gold”); it adds “I want” and restructures the verse.
NASB reorders the verse and renders “the fear of God” as “godliness.”
NASB renders “was formed” as “was … created” and adds “it was … who.”
NASB follows the critical text (“being quite deceived”); it adds “fell.”
NASB supplies “women” as the subject and renders “saved” as “preserved”; the meaning is uncertain.
